# WizeStream fork notes

This directory is based on `electron-mpv-video` 0.1.1 (MIT), published at
https://github.com/yscoder/electron-mpv-video.

WizeStream adds Linux x64/arm64 and macOS x64 native builds, HTTP(S)-only composite media opening,
narrow external audio/caption switching operations, a validated ten-band equalizer operation,
validated playback speed, pitch, and silence-skipping controls, and per-operation exact or keyframe
seeking.
Generic libmpv commands are intentionally not exposed. The upstream license and third-party notices
are retained in this directory.
